name: Floating Menu
summary: A pill at the bottom centre of a screen that widens into a panel of links when opened, with staggered item reveals and Escape to close.
useWhen: A mobile app or full-screen tool that needs its main links one tap away without a top bar
A compact menu anchored to the bottom of a canvas or map, where a sidebar would take too much room
avoidWhen: Desktop apps with many sections, where a sidebar or menubar fits better
Site headers that must show links on every screen size, where navigation-menu fits better
